formulas.formula: Your income, your rules: a budget built for a mom doing it all, with child support and co-parent costs in one place.
1. Setup: your take-home pay, other income (benefits, side work), child support, the co-parent's share of kid costs, and your kids' names.
2. Budget Plan: every monthly expense, grouped, marked Need, Want or Save. Give every dollar a job until Left to Plan is $0.
3. Spending: log what you spend (and savings transfers). Add a child's name if it was for one of the kids.
4. Child Support: log every payment. See what was expected, what arrived, and how far behind it is.
5. Co-Parent: shared kid costs (braces, camp, school trips). See their share, what they've paid back and what they still owe.
6. This Month, Year and Kids: plan vs spent, every group, every child.
7. Safety Net and Goals: emergency fund months, life insurance check, and your savings goals.
Not always on time? Pick No for 'Count child support in the budget' and plan on your own income only.
Keep receipts! Tick Receipt Sent when you've sent the co-parent their copy.
Leave it blank to use the % on Setup. Type a different % for a cost you agreed to split differently.
Start with $1,000, then build to 3 months of Need spending, then 6.
Add SNAP, child tax credits or other help under Other Income on Setup.
Clear the white cells on every tab, then update Setup.
Tinted cells: these calculate for you.
Green: paid, on track, or money left.
Yellow: short, or almost at the limit.
Red: over plan, behind, or something to check.
